L4-setup.claim: L4: 2 stencil panels (p-diamond r0-10, M-bar r11-21). Blob r11-39 c27-46. Tip 4x4 r19-22 c35-38. Head right c51+ blocked by r c47-49. M socket left. N 2x2 in blob r28-29 c44-45.

charge-effects.claim: p-diamond=toggle tip 4x4<->2x2. Y=teleport tip to ring of current key. M-bar=beam exits b-half dir, passes charcoal, stops at M-socket, destroys socket+ALL cells of its core colour(r or O). Goal=tip into head core.

level1-SOLUTION.claim: Set grid green == panel pattern (panel click stencils W). Match -> transfer: grid resets, tip shrinks 4x4->2x2. Then slide tip toward head; only 2x2 fits keyway. Reaching head = complete.

level1-controls.claim: LEFT/RIGHT slide tip 4 cols along track (RIGHT at far right = error flash anim). UP rotates tip 90cw; DOWN flips vertically. MOUSE on grid cell toggles it to N(green) or back to base color. MOUSE elsewhere = error flash.

level1-objects.claim: Top: key=head(blue frame+sky core) cols12-16, gray shaft track cols17-42 rows19-22, sliding tip(b/S 2 halves). Bottom-left: static panel G with 4 purple dots diamond. Bottom-right: 3x3 grid of 3x3 cells, click toggles g/W base <-> N green.

level1-transfer.claim: When grid pattern == panel diamond (4 green at edge-centers), the 4th click triggers 9-frame animation: grid resets to all gray, tip size changes 4x4->2x2->4x4 (oscillating), tip center drifts left ~1 col.
